workarounds.note: a paragraph style's margins do not count inside a box, so each column title is followed by :::space{lines=0.5} in the Markdown instead of a marginBottom
paragraph styles have no italic, so every English line carries its own *…* instead of an italic verse style for the translation
the drawing over the poems reserves no height, so the poems opener sets minHeight to 11 grid lines, which with the level's one-line bottom margin ends the heading at the drawing's foot
the poems opener has span: 'page' in a single-column layout, because its drawing starts at the top edge of the page, above the column that would clip it
level 1's breakBefore (parity 'any') is restated because a headings object drops it
col() writes the hex beside every paletteId, because the elements of the running heads, the drop folio and the two heading designs do not read the palette
the design titles give lineHeight as a multiple (1), never as a dimension
column balancing moved poem III, the last box on page 4, 22.5 mm down to the page's last line; headings.balancing.enabled: false, the only switch in 1.4.1, keeps it 12.3 mm under poem II
the note's locale is the exact code 'es' or 'en-us', the only forms the hyphenation patterns match

the note's heading places its title from the container's top-left corner, 36 mm down: anchored to the bottom edge of a 36 mm minHeight instead, 1.4.1 drops the whole reservation and the note starts under a one-line heading
